I've been sifting dozens of videos looking for quality compilations of real parkour for this sub.

I wanted to share a simple pattern I found to find the good stuff.

Look at the beginning of a video, or even the thumbnail.

**If it is focused on hand rails and retaining walls,** there is a 99% chance it will be kids doing flips. Every once in a while you will see some crazy rebounding from wall to wall, but this is rare.

**If there are buildings but no "common" parkour obstacles,** there is a 50% chance it will kick ass. If there's no hand rails and retaining walls around, it's either going to involve getting up/down the buildings (and thus be good) or else it will be kids doing random flips on flat ground.

**If it starts with a fish eye lens from a rooftop,** *WEW LAD, STRAP YOURSELF IN!* If they're already up somewhere high then they have the capacity to get to high places, and if the camera is rolling they're getting ready for something crazy to go down.
